reviewType: independent actual integration controls, pre-freeze; not canonical acceptance

findings.title: Multiple independently provisioned stores replay the same campaign
findings.detail: Campaign validates only root/custody basenames; provision has no globally unique campaign registration or pinned absolute store/custody identity. Two arbitrary parents can each provision this campaign, obtain separate locks, and dispatch the same first target. Therefore one-call-per-target, concurrency1 and 100-total apply only per chosen directory pair, not to the authorized campaign.
findings.evidence: Offline mocked gates/transport reproduction created two temporary parent directories, called provision/run_next once each, and observed two transport invocations for sd2-read-0ecb63a87a257aeb15ea. No source/provider calls.
findings.requiredRemediation: Bind one immutable campaign store/custody identity and exclusive global registration before provisioning, and reject alternate store paths and concurrent duplicate campaign instances; independently test this boundary.

findings.title: Caller-selected local custody does not enforce externally anchored current cursor
findings.detail: Custody is an ordinary caller-selected directory written by the same process. audit derives its head only from the mutable local event/receipt/custody files, and run_next accepts this locally derived head. No trusted external last committed cursor or non-rollback append-only anchor is authenticated. A consistent rollback/loss of the entire local pair to a prior valid prefix therefore appears current and permits redispatch; matching file sequences catch partial loss only. This fails section19 current external append-only receipt plus last committed campaign cursor requirement.
findings.requiredRemediation: Use an independently retained append-only campaign head/cursor with authenticated identity, verify its exact current value under campaign exclusion, and fail closed on missing/rollback/replaced custody. Add rollback-of-consistent-prefix integration coverage.

checks.duplicateCampaignOfflineReproduction: FAIL: two mocked invocations of same target from two permitted directory pairs

limitations: Provider/main authentication and real transport inspected statically and existing offline tests only; no live external calls authorized in this review.
